title: 第6585章 小家伙吹牛了第6584章 虚空雷池
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 死死盯着面前虚空雷池，苏辰双拳静静地握着。
这次损失白来了。
不仅没有得到任何的好处，甚至元神还被重创，真的是得不偿失的事情。
不过，苏辰也没有丝毫的后悔。
要是再来一次，他还是会毫不犹豫地如此选择。
原因很简单。
囚兕吞噬虚空雷池的力量，遭受虚空雷池的意识攻击，要是不来的话，他也不知道虚空雷池会诞生出意识。
“老大，我们继续吗？”
“你可以？”
囚兕想了想，说道：“我没有问题，我甚至能够有机会吞噬意识，不过你却是无法继续踏足虚空雷池。”
一听此话，苏辰瞬间明白小家伙的意思。
不管是自己还是小家伙，只要有人能够得到机缘，都是极好的事情，总比两手空空离开要强得多。
想到这里的苏辰，点点头说道：“你自己小心，要是扛不住立刻退出来，不要逞强。”
“明白。”
“老大，我想跟着囚兕一起。”
小胖点点头，笑着说道：“我要是单单一人肯定不行，但我要是有着囚兕的相助，却是没有任何的问题。”
苏辰没有全部相信小胖，不管发生什么事情，他都不愿意看到小胖有事，出现任何的意外。
正是如此，苏辰看向囚兕，就是想要问问囚兕的意见。
“老大，没有问题，我会照顾好胖哥的。”
“小心。”
看着快速而去的两个小家伙，要说没有丝毫的担心，那肯定是骗人的，毕竟就算是囚兕能够吞噬雷电力量，也不敢保证一定可以全身而退。
而现在的他，肯定是无法继续踏足虚空雷池，毕竟刚刚的元神攻击，要不是以内混沌吞噬塔，相信元神已经崩碎。
对于囚兕来说，这便是千载难逢的机会，他也不愿意看到小家伙错失机会。
现在的他，只能等着。
希望两个小家伙不要有事。
混沌吞噬塔内。
“塔灵，有事？”
苏辰很清楚，要是没有特殊的事情，一般情况下，塔灵是不会随意召唤自己。
塔灵点点头说道：“主人，囚兕作为十八混沌金刚之一，我总是感觉他不对劲，你要小心提防。”
听到此话的苏辰显得很是惊讶，本身他就很是提防囚兕，只是没有想到，连塔灵都如此说，看来自己的猜测是没有错的。
“有苗头？”
“现在的他还未觉醒，或者是说，他就算是觉醒了，要是故意隐藏，我担心他会对你不利。”
十八混沌金刚，现在共知道三人。
content_en:
Staring at the empty thunder pool in front of him, Su Chen quietly clenched his fists.
This loss was in vain.
Not only did he not get any benefits, but his soul was also severely damaged. It was really a loss that outweighed the gains.
However, Su Chen didn't regret it at all.
If it were to happen again, he would still choose this without hesitation.
The reason is simple.
Qi Si swallowed up the power of the Void Thunder Pond and was attacked by the Void Thunder Pond's consciousness. If he hadn't come, he would not have known that the Void Thunder Pond would give birth to consciousness.
"Boss, shall we continue?"
"Can you?"
Qiu Si thought for a while and said: "I have no problem. I can even have the opportunity to swallow consciousness, but you can't continue to set foot in the Void Thunder Pond."
Upon hearing this, Su Chen instantly understood what the little guy meant.
Whether it's you or a little guy, as long as someone can get an opportunity, it's a great thing, and it's always better than leaving empty-handed.
Thinking of this, Su Chen nodded and said, "Be careful. If you can't bear it, quit immediately. Don't show off."
"Understood."
"Boss, I want to follow Qi Si."
"You?"
Xiaopang nodded and said with a smile: "I definitely can't do it alone, but if I have Qiu Si's help, there won't be any problem."
Su Chen didn't believe everything about Fatty. No matter what happened, he didn't want to see anything happen to Fatty or any accidents.
Just like this, Su Chen looked at Qiu Si, just wanting to ask Qiu Si's opinion.
"Boss, there's no problem. I will take good care of Fat Brother."
"Be careful."
Looking at the two little guys walking away quickly, it would be a lie to say that they were not worried at all. After all, even if Qiu Si could swallow the power of thunder and lightning, there was no guarantee that he would be able to escape unscathed.
But now, he will definitely not be able to continue to set foot in the Void Thunder Pond. After all, if the Yuan Shen attack just now had not consumed the Chaos Devouring Tower, I believe the Yuan Shen would have collapsed.
For Qi Si, this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and he didn't want to see the little guy miss the opportunity.
Now he can only wait.
I hope nothing happens to the two little guys.
Chaos engulfs the tower.
"Ta Ling, is something wrong?"
Su Chen knew very well that unless there was something special, under normal circumstances, the tower spirit would not summon him at will.
The tower spirit nodded and said: "Master, Qi Si is one of the Eighteen Chaos King Kongs. I always feel that something is wrong with him. You must be careful."
Su Chen looked very surprised when he heard this. He was very wary of Qi Si, but he didn't expect that even the tower spirit would say so. It seemed that his guess was correct.
"Any indication?"
"He hasn't awakened yet, or in other words, even if he has awakened, if he hides it deliberately, I'm worried that he will be detrimental to you."
There are currently three of the eighteen Chaos King Kongs.
